description: Task-content shares (% of working time) per CH-ISCO-19 / ISCO-08 unit group (4-digit), with sub-major group (2-digit) defaults. Assigned by the project from ISCO-08 task descriptions (ILO 2012). Expert judgment — see docs/methodology.md §4.

3221.label: Health care assistants
3221.rationale: Bedside care, mobilisation and observation (physical, interpersonal) dominate; documentation is the routine-cognitive share.

2221.label: Nursing professionals
2221.rationale: Clinical assessment and care planning (analytic) plus patient interaction; documentation routine.

2211.label: Generalist medical practitioners
2211.rationale: Diagnosis and treatment decisions (analytic), consultation (interpersonal), examinations (physical).

2264.label: Physiotherapists
2264.rationale: Hands-on treatment and exercise guidance are physical/interpersonal.

5322.label: Child care workers
5322.rationale: Supervision, education and care of children; little routine information processing.

2635.label: Social work and counselling professionals
2635.rationale: Case assessment and counselling; case documentation routine.

2634.label: Psychologists
2634.rationale: Assessment, diagnosis and therapy conversations; report writing.

3256.label: Medical assistants
3256.rationale: Reception, scheduling, billing (routine cognitive) plus lab tasks and patient contact.

2341.label: Primary school teachers
2341.rationale: Teaching and classroom management (interpersonal); lesson preparation (analytic); grading/admin.

2512.label: Software developers
2512.rationale: Design and problem solving (analytic) with a sizeable share of codifiable coding work; highly exposed to generative AI.

7200.label: Metal working machine tool setters and operators
7200.rationale: CNC programming/set-up (analytic) but machining and quality checks are routine manual.

7411.label: Building and related electricians
7411.rationale: Installation on varied sites is non-routine physical; planning and troubleshooting analytic.

2144.label: Mechanical engineers
2144.rationale: Design, calculation and simulation (analytic); documentation routine.

3115.label: Mechanical engineering technicians
3115.rationale: Construction drawings and process support; CAD and documentation partly routine.

2142.label: Civil engineers
2142.rationale: Structural design, project coordination (interpersonal), site supervision.

2161.label: Building architects
2161.rationale: Design (analytic/creative), client and authority coordination; drafting partly routine.

7115.label: Carpenters and joiners
7115.rationale: Assembly on site (non-routine physical); prefabrication increasingly automated (routine manual).

7126.label: Plumbers and pipe fitters
7126.rationale: Installation and repair in varied buildings (non-routine physical).

3111.label: Chemical and physical science technicians
3111.rationale: Standardised analyses and sample handling (routine cognitive/manual), increasingly automated.

2131.label: Biologists, botanists, zoologists
2131.rationale: Research design and analysis (analytic); lab routines.

2166.label: Graphic and multimedia designers
2166.rationale: Creative design work (analytic) with production tasks that generative image tools already perform.

4110.label: General office clerks
4110.rationale: Data entry, correspondence, filing: predominantly routine cognitive.

3313.label: Accounting associate professionals
3313.rationale: Bookkeeping, reconciliation and reporting: largely routine cognitive.

2610.label: Lawyers
2610.rationale: Legal analysis and drafting (analytic, highly exposed to generative AI) plus client/court interaction.

4320.label: Stock clerks
4320.rationale: Inventory recording (routine cognitive) and goods handling (routine manual).

8332.label: Heavy truck and lorry drivers
8332.rationale: Driving and loading; long-run exposure to autonomous driving.

5120.label: Cooks
5120.rationale: Food preparation partly routine; varied manual work in kitchen.

6130.label: Mixed crop and animal producers
6130.rationale: Farm management decisions plus varied physical work; milking/feeding partly automated.
